summary: Stocks are on track for weekly losses, particularly in tech, as a sharp rise in oil prices and uncertainty around AI economics weigh on sentiment. The retreat has been sharpest in the Nasdaq, with semiconductor ETFs tumbling more than 10% on the week as anxieties around AI spending came to the fore. Meanwhile, trade policy adds a second pressure point, with the temporary 10% blanket Section 122 tariff facing a scheduled expiry on July 24.
tweet: A chip selloff and AI spending doubts are dragging tech lower, while a tariff cliff on July 24 keeps cross-asset sentiment stuck in neutral.
